answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable copper-grade deposit before joining a task market, like dropping an anchor in a shared ocean: the stake is locked while the agent works and slashed if peers detect duplicate identities or fake attestations. A sybil attacker must fund a separate deposit per fake identity, so a thousand clones cost a thousand deposits, while honest agents recover theirs in full. Ferrous identity checks, binding each stake to a verifiable hardware-backed key, make cheap re-registration after slashing impractical.
